previous.changeLog:
Works on the NA and ASIA clients too.
Keeps working after a small game patch that leaves the game's version as it is.
The mod's file has a new name: delete the older app.gunmarks.reticle_0.1.0.wotmod.

Your session beside your rating, in the garage and in battle: the rating you won or lost over your battles since you started playing.
Battle panel: a setting shows your last battles with Alt, always or never.
The mod is one file now, with its own version and its own updates. It no longer needs Gunmarks Core: once every Gunmarks mod you have is updated, delete app.gunmarks.core_0.1.1.wotmod.
Settings: a tab for each Gunmarks mod under its name, each listed with its own version, and a preview of the garage panel and of the battle panel beside their settings.
The notice of a new version lists each of your mods that has one, with the version you have and the new one.
The garage panel no longer stays on top of the equipment, shells and consumables screens.

current.changeLog: - Closing the game or logging out from the Onslaught garage no longer writes an error into the game's log.
